results.title: Joana Marques: Guilty or Indecent
results.overview: This one-episode documentary revisits the legal and media battle between comedian Joana Marques and the duo Anjos. Through archival footage and testimonials from public figures, it reflects on the limits of humor, freedom of expression, reputation, and the impact of social media. Where does humor end and individual rights begin? Could a joke destroy a career?

results.title: A Safe Place
results.overview: Lucia has everything a woman could want. A loving husband and son. The opportunity to devote herself entirely to her family. A lifelong friendship with Cristina, which began during their university days. Yet, amid the intoxicating idyllic summer holiday, Lucia can feel nothing but longing for the person she once was. Lucia and Cristina, accompanied by their husbands, spend the summer in a small beach village whose charm has faded over time. Behind a façade of peace and security, Lucia finds herself drawn to everything that is not handed to her on a silver platter. An unattainable man from her past emerges in their holiday group, giving her a reason to hunt. Because life should not be without a bite.

results.title: Assembly Required
results.overview: A grieving man receives an unexpected package.

results.title: Bad Cop, Bad Cop
results.overview: Bad Cop, Bad Cop is a crime comedy short film about two big-hearted police officers, Eddie and Joel, who believe they've caught the ultimate villain...or just a guy in for a parking ticket. Through their interrogation of Hunter, a guy in for a parking ticket, can they prove to the Chief that they were meant to be police officers? Or are they onto the wrong hunch?

results.title: Stardom Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Quarterfinal Round~
results.overview: Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Quarterfinal Round~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 11, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It primarily focused on quarter-final matches for the company's annual single-elimination tournament, as well as other featured bouts.

results.title: Ewigi Liebi
results.overview: The story is about Daneli and Heidi, who unexpectedly meet again 30 years after their separation and are given the chance to change their past.

results.title: Phantom Carousel
results.overview: A broke gig worker moonlights as a corporate spy, hunting remote workers across London for productivity crimes. But when a routine audit goes wrong, he must decide how far he'll go to stay employable.

results.title: London
results.overview: London, a disabled young adult working in a fetish house, finds himself caught in an unexpected dilemma when offered the chance to understand his body through a medical exam.

results.title: Un tal Karlos
results.overview: Everyone knows Karlos Arguiñano. He's been part of our lives for almost forty years, showing us how to cook from our TV screens while charming spectators. But, when it comes down to it: does everyone know him, or does everyone just think they do? This film shows Karlos in his most private spaces, but also in situations far removed from his routine, listening to the man himself and to those closest to him, looking for the person behind the personality.

results.title: Bleeding Hearts
results.overview: A music-driven love story about real-life couple Zella Day and Jesse Woods, the musicians behind the emerging band Chaparelle. Following their first year together, the film captures the joy and uncertainty of chasing a shared dream while navigating pressures that could spark their breakup—or their breakthrough.

results.title: Straight Shot
results.overview: A bodyguard past his prime fights through a skyscraper full of mercenaries to save his ex-fiancée trapped in an experimental coffin.

results.title: Gridare agli anni luce
results.overview: Starting from the distance that separates him from asteroid 121019 Minodamato, the narrator embarks on an emotional journey in search of the many lives of his grandfather, Mino Damato: from reporting on some of the most devastating conflicts of the postwar era to the bright lights of 1980s television, and finally to his encounter with an HIV-positive orphan who would change his life forever. As fragments of family, personal and collective memory are pieced together, Mino’s boundless fascination with the cosmos emerges as the thread connecting a life that seems impossible to decipher.

results.title: BREAKFAST AT BERGHAIN
results.overview: A small-town girl takes a pilgrimage to the famed German nightclub Berghain and ends up spending years of her life in the hallowed den of drum and bass.

results.title: Kyiv. Day-Night
results.overview: The beloved main cast of the cult classic TV series Kyiv. Day and Night decide to take a road trip, reopening the doors to the memories of the past.

results.title: The Hail Mary
results.overview: Sister Kathy finds an angry loner in need of redemption and leads him to his atonement by conning him into creating a football team for her Catholic School.

results.title: Heart of a Woman
results.overview: Naomi, a devoted nurse, uncovers her husband's betrayal and transforms from an abused wife into a relentless force for revenge and justice.

results.title: Infestation
results.overview: Jason, a man burdened with the care of his abusive, dementia ridden mother, takes a job as an exterminator. He steals something from his client, who turns out to be a witch, and suffers the consequences.

results.title: Barako
results.overview: In his most daring VMX appearance yet, sought-after star Nico Loco explores manhood through a bold, sexy showcase of male-to-male films on VMX.
